entities.name: Vronos
entities.description: Planeswalker from Innistrad called the Gray Fencer, a former Elite Inquisitor killed by Garruk Wildspeaker.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Charged Vronos with finding Garruk so she could heal him.

entities.name: Vedalken Ethersworn
entities.description: Alaran vedalken who studied the wounded Vronos.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane where Vronos ended up wounded.

events.summary: Attacked by young werewolves, Vronos's spark ignites and he ends up wounded on Alara.
events.quote: When he was attacked by a pack of young werewolves his planeswalker's spark ignited

events.summary: Vronos returns to Innistrad as a penitent.

events.summary: Avacyn charges Vronos with finding the cursed Garruk Wildspeaker so she can heal him.
events.quote: He was then charged by Avacyn to find the cursed Garruk Wildspeaker

events.summary: Vronos fails and is killed by Garruk.
events.quote: He failed and was killed by Garruk instead.
